name: Jephthah
overview: Jephthah is a male judge of Israel known for being a valiant warrior, as described in Judges 11:1. His role as a leader and warrior highlights his significance during a turbulent period in Israel's history. Scripture identifies him specifically as a courageous figure who delivered Israel from its enemies.
namesAndTitles: The name Jephthah means 'YHWH opens, frees,' reflecting a divine aspect of liberation associated with his character. This proper name, recorded in Judges 11:1, underscores the theme of God’s deliverance through him, though the name was not given by God directly.
familyAndRelationships: Jephthah is explicitly identified as the son of Gilead in Judges 11:1. Beyond this, Scripture does not record any additional family relationships for him, focusing primarily on his role as a warrior and judge.
scriptureSignificance: Jephthah's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his leadership as a judge who delivered Israel through his valor in battle. His story exemplifies God raising up leaders to free His people in times of need. The meaning of his name complements this role, emphasizing divine freedom and opening of the way for Israel’s victory.
